decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun not later than three years from the date of the original planning permission ref: 2025/2614 (dated 06.10.25).
Reason: To prevent the accumulation of unimplemented planning permissions and to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended) and to meet the requirements of Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004 and to meet the requirements of The Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (England) Order 2015.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out in accordance with the following reports, specifications and drawings detailed P-210 Rev. 01, P-211 Rev. 01, P-212 Rev. 02, P-213 Rev. 01, P-214 Rev. 01, P-215 Rev. 01, P-230 Rev. 01, P-240 Rev. 01, P-241 Rev. 01, P-242 Rev. 01 and the Fire Safety Report approved under planning permission ref: 2025/2614. 
Reason: To ensure a satisfactory standard of development and to allow the local planning authority to review any potential changes to the scheme.

Condition : 3 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out strictly in accordance with the external materials and finished detailed on the approved plans listed on this decision notice, and the Material Schedule in Section 6 of the Design and Access Statement (July 2025) approved under planning permission ref: 2025/2614. 
Reason: To preserve the Grade II Listed Building at the site and in the interest of the appearance of the surrounding Conservation Area, in accordance with Council policies LP1 and LP3 of the Local Plan coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework.
Condition : 4 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out strictly in accordance with the window and door details specified in Appendix 5 'Historic doors to be retained/relocated'; Appendix 6 'Window Schedule'; Appendix 7 'Details of Individual secondary glazing proposed for window 7'; and Appendix 8 'Example of Oculus window partition proposed at ground floor level' of the submitted Heritage Statement (14.07.2025) approved under planning permission ref: 2025/2614. 
Reason: To preserve the Grade II Listed Building at the site and to ensure a high quality of development and to accord with policies LP1 and LP3 of the Local Plan coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework.

Condition : 5 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out strictly in accordance with the repointing and repair to brickwork details specified in the Contractor Method Statement (02.07.2025) approved under planning permission ref: 2025/2614. 
Reason: To ensure a high quality of development and to accord with policies LP1 and LP3 of the Local Plan coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework.

Condition : 6 - Prior to the first occupation of the development, the refuse and recycling storage shown on approved drawings shall be provided and shall be retained for the users of the development and for no other purpose.
Reason: To ensure adequate provision is made for waste storage in accordance with Council policies LP1 and LP2 of the Local Plan coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework.
Condition : 7 - Prior to the first occupation of the development the cycle parking shown on the approved drawing shall be provided, and be retained for cycle parking purposes for the users of the development and for no other purpose. 
Reason: To ensure adequate provision is made for cycle parking in accordance with Council policies LP27 and LP51 of the Wandsworth Local Plan coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework.
Condition : 8 - The use of the property as a House in Multiple occupation (HMO) shall at all times be operated in full accordance with the details and measures set out in the submitted HMO Management Plan approved under planning permission ref: 2025/2614, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. 
Reason: To ensure satisfactory management of the property in the interests of the amenities of neighbouring occupiers, in accordance with Policy LP2 of the Local Plan coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework.
Condition : 9 - The House in Multiple Occupation (HMO) hereby approved shall be occupied by no more than 20 persons at any one time. 
Reason: To safeguard the amenities of neighbouring occupiers and to ensure that the intensity of occupation remains compatible with the character of the surrounding area, in accordance with Policies LP1 and LP2 of the Local Plan coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework.
Condition : 10 - No cooking facilities, including ovens, hobs, microwave ovens or other fixed cooking appliances, shall be installed within any of the individual HMO bedrooms hereby approved. Cooking facilities shall only be provided within the communal kitchen areas as shown on the approved plans. 
Reason: To ensure that the development operates as an HMO with shared communal facilities and to prevent the creation of substandard self-contained residential units, in accordance with Policies LP27 and LP29 of the Local Plan coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework.

Condition : 11 - INFORMATIVE: In dealing with this application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to work with the applicant in a positive and proactive manner and the Council has, as far as practicable, sought solutions to problems arising in relation to dealing with the planning application. The Council has made available detailed advice in the form of its statutory policies in the Local Plan (2023) as well as offering a full pre-application advice service, in order to ensure that the applicant has been given every opportunity to submit an application which is likely to be considered favourably. In addition, where appropriate, further guidance was offered to the applicant during the processing of the application.
Condition : 12 - Informative: The applicant is advised that this decision notice relates only to the grant of planning permission. The applicant should ensure that the approved drawings and works authorised by this permission are also the subject of a corresponding Listed Building Consent. Works affecting the listed building must not be undertaken unless the necessary Listed Building Consent has been granted. Undertaking such works without consent may constitute a criminal offence under the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990.
description: Variation of Condition 2 (approved drawings) pursuant to planning permission dated 06/10/2025 ref 2025/2614, as amended by non-material amendment ref 2025/4577 (Alterations including conversion of the existing residential flat at lower ground floor into five HMO rooms to be used in connection with the existing HMO (Sui Generis) on upper floors, internal and external refurbishment and reconfiguration/ remodelling of existing HMO, including replacement windows; erection of rear dormer window and replacement of two existing rear dormers; erection of new cycle storey & bin enclosure (following removal of existing structures) and increase in height of front boundary wall) to allow minor internal and external adjustments to the approved drawings.
